meta.title: DSH work process 3D live view
meta.description: Adds a "3D process" tab to the view tabs of every conversation. It shows the conversation's work as a 3D precision factory on the open roof of a skyscraper: a fuel tank for your DeepSeek balance, an engine and console for the generation rate, context pressure and token counters, ten tool stations that process a wafer for each tool call and show their status and latest outcomes on holographic readouts, a subagent dock whose drones carry out subagent and workflow tasks, a stocker that stores each turn as a batch, and big curved screens you can look at up close. A ringed planet, a moon and the stars fill the sky in three looks (dusk, daylight and night), an infinity pool runs along the balcony, and background music follows the scene (it can be turned off in the toolbar). The data comes from the plugin's Host session projection, so restart DSH once after installing or updating; Display also offers a demo session. Orbit and roam camera modes and views such as Overview, Fuel, Engine, Stations, Dock, Products, Living, Balcony and Pool are included. It needs WebGL 2 with hardware acceleration; quality starts from your GPU and drops automatically when the frame rate is low.
